# B2B Digital Funnel Architecture Guide

## Core architecture
Traffic source -> Landing page -> Intent capture -> CRM lead -> Qualification -> Sales follow-up -> Opportunity -> Quote -> Order -> Payment -> Revenue.

## Attribution
Persist first-touch source, medium and campaign while also recording meaningful later interactions.

## Landing page
One page should have one dominant business outcome. Keep proof, offer, qualification and CTA close together.

## CRM handoff
A new lead should have:
- source
- requested outcome
- owner
- next action
- next-action due time
- resource or offer that generated intent

## Automation
Automate repetitive routing and reminders, not judgment-heavy commercial decisions.

## Measurement
Do not stop at traffic or downloads. Connect resource consumption to qualification, opportunity, order, payment and revenue outcomes.

## Failure recovery
Every automated handoff needs an observable status and a manual recovery path.
